description: Stop shipping agents on vibes. Score every agent output for quality, safety, and cost.
name: io.github.iris-eval/mcp-server

environmentVariables.description: API key for HTTP authentication (optional, recommended for production)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Log level: debug, info, warn, error
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_LOG_LEVEL

environmentVariables.description: Directory for the database, custom rules and preferences (default ~/.iris)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_HOME

environmentVariables.description: Enables evaluate_with_llm_judge and verify_citations with an Anthropic model. Optional: the deterministic rules never need a key
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Enables evaluate_with_llm_judge and verify_citations with an OpenAI model. Optional: the deterministic rules never need a key
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_OPENAI_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Hard cap on the worst-case cost of one judge or citation call (default 0.25)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_LLM_JUDGE_MAX_COST_USD_PER_EVAL

environmentVariables.description: Let verify_citations fetch URLs (off by default)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_CITATION_ALLOW_FETCH

environmentVariables.description: Start the dashboard alongside the server (same as --dashboard)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_DASHBOARD

environmentVariables.description: Dashboard port (default 6920); IRIS_PORT is the MCP HTTP transport port (default 3000)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_DASHBOARD_PORT
